data.body:
Goal:
Deliver safe, remotely enforced, lossless Knots compaction across GitHub and Diffinite repositories without deleting rollback archives.

Verification:
1. Verify every referenced Knot reaches SHIPPED under knots-e2e.
2. Verify provider rejection/acceptance probes, released-client compatibility, fresh-clone equivalence, SQLite rollback, and scale targets.
3. Verify canary-first live rollout records canonical generations for every discovered remote-backed Knots repository.

Constraints:
Use the approved provider and SQLite changes. Use existing hosts and rails. Enable the old-reader poison tripwire. Keep all archives, packs, generations, and legacy refs indefinitely.
data.title: Deliver protected protocol-v2 compaction
